capabilities: Open .docx files from the file explorer in a dedicated read-only view
Inspect document structure such as headings, lists, tables, footnotes, and endnotes
View comments, hyperlinks, media references, and media metadata
Filter document text, headings, comments, notes, and media metadata
Warn about risky package content like external relationships, macros, tracked changes, and encrypted or malformed files
disambiguation: Not a Word editor or converter; it only displays .docx content read-only with no editing, export, or Markdown write-back.
extras: Explicit non-goals section states no .doc legacy support, no macro execution, no editing, and no network calls; README also includes a security/privacy statement and manual install steps from GitHub releases.
problem: Obsidian cannot display Microsoft Word .docx documents natively, so their content and structure are inaccessible without leaving the app or launching an external program.
summary: Read-only viewer that opens .docx files inside Obsidian, showing text, headings, tables, comments, footnotes, media metadata, and package diagnostics.
